 past the fit the map grows from the frame's top left corner, so the pan moves by the growth before that point.

nodes.name: toggleCompact
nodes.documentation: Stubs or names the functions off the flow. Compact starts on at every load; nothing stores it.

nodes.name: pans
nodes.documentation: True when a move by a screen delta changes the pan; at its limit a scroll goes to the page instead.

nodes.name: showFull
nodes.documentation: Sets the page class and the full screen button for one mode. The button names its key while the shortcuts are on.

nodes.name: setFull
nodes.documentation:
Shows the code full screen over the canvas with no connectors, or returns to the canvas with its connectors drawn at once.
 At rest there is no code, so full screen does not open.

nodes.name: layoutTop
nodes.documentation: Puts the flow band right of the map tools, and the canvas frame below both.

nodes.name: lidPathLength
nodes.documentation:
The characters of a file path that a lid makes room for: "…/" and the file name, or a shorter whole path.
 The lid cuts a longer path from its start, so the deck stays narrow and the file name shows.

nodes.name: boxWidth
nodes.signature: const boxWidth = (name: string, file: string, steps: readonly number[], away: boolean)
nodes.documentation: The width of a lifted box: its name (or the end of its file path when it lives in another file) and its step numbers.

nodes.name: deckSize
nodes.signature: function deckSize(clusters: readonly (readonly { name: string; file: string; steps: readonly number[] }[])[]): { width: number; maxHeight: number }
parameters: clusters: readonly (readonly { name: string; file: string; steps: readonly number[] }[])[]
nodes.documentation: One width and the tallest height over every cluster, so the pinned deck never changes width and always fits.

nodes.name: home
nodes.documentation: The deck-plane place of the i-th box.

nodes.name: deckDepth
nodes.documentation: The deck's screen height at 100%: from its raised top edge down to its cast shadow.

nodes.name: deckSpot
nodes.signature: function deckSpot(frame: Frame, codeLeft: number, deckWidth: number, maxHeight: number, k: number): { x: number; y: number }
nodes.documentation: The pinned deck spot on screen at zoom k. The right edge and the top edge stay put; the deck grows left and down.

nodes.name: fileRoom
nodes.signature: const fileRoom = (frameLeft: number, deckLeft: number, k: number)
nodes.documentation: The room for the file box rows left of the deck, in box pixels from the box's left edge.

nodes.name: deckTransform
nodes.signature: const deckTransform = (spot: { x: number; y: number }, anchor: { x: number; y: number }, k: number)
nodes.documentation: The deck's CSS transform inside the canvas, which scales by k around the anchor, so the deck stays at its spot.

nodes.name: fileBoxCenter
nodes.signature: function fileBoxCenter(rowY: number, frame: Frame, fileHeight: number, k: number): number
nodes.documentation:
The screen y of the file node's center: level with its explorer row, unless the box would leave the frame.
 The box top sits 10 box px above the node's center.

nodes.name: roomOf
nodes.documentation: The room for the file box and the deck at 100%, between the file box's left edge and the deck's pinned right edge.

nodes.name: zoomFit
nodes.signature: function zoomFit(frame: Frame, codeLeft: number, deck: { width: number; maxHeight: number }, fileRight: number, fileMin: number): { start: number; max: number; wide: number }
nodes.returnType: { start: number; max: number; wide: number }
nodes.documentation:
The zoom range of a frame. `wide` is the largest zoom at which the widest flow file box (`fileRight`) ends CLEAR px
 before the deck, but not under the floor: there the names end in an ellipsis. The floor gives way where even the
 narrowest rows (`fileMin`) would reach the deck. `max` is `wide` lowered to where the deck fits the frame height:
 the largest zoom that shows the whole map. `start` is that fit in 10% steps, from the floor to 100%.

nodes.name: deckShift
nodes.signature: const deckShift = (frame: Frame, codeLeft: number, wide: number, k: number)
nodes.documentation:
How far the deck moves right of its pinned spot at zoom k. Past the width fit `wide` the map grows as it does at the fit,
 so the rows keep their room before the deck, and the deck leaves the frame on the right.

nodes.name: deckBelow
nodes.signature: const deckBelow = (frameHeight: number, maxHeight: number, k: number)
nodes.documentation: How far the deck reaches below the frame at zoom k, 4 px inside its edge, where the deck no longer fits its height.

nodes.name: ExplorerRow
nodes.documentation:
One explorer row. A directory path ends with "/". `files` holds every file at or under the row.
 `pos` is the row's place among its `size` siblings, from 1.

nodes.name: buildExplorer
nodes.documentation: Builds the rows in tree order. The tree already lists files before subdirectories, each in name order.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.signature: const walk = (node: DeckTree, path: string, parent: ExplorerRow | null, depth: number): string[]

nodes.name: guideKinds
nodes.documentation: One cell per ancestor below the root (pipe or gap), then a tee or a rounded end for the row itself.

nodes.name: openTo
nodes.documentation: Opens every directory above a row.

nodes.name: isShown
nodes.signature: function isShown(row: ExplorerRow, open: ReadonlySet<string>): boolean
nodes.documentation: True when every directory above the row is open.

nodes.name: anchorRow
nodes.signature: function anchorRow(row: ExplorerRow, open: ReadonlySet<string>): ExplorerRow
nodes.documentation: Returns the row, or its nearest shown directory when a closed directory holds it.

nodes.name: dirNote
nodes.documentation: Returns the note of a closed directory ("+3 files"), or "" for an open one or a file.

nodes.name: fileBox
nodes.documentation: Lays out the rows of one file for one step.

nodes.name: span
nodes.signature: const span = (cls: string, s: string): string

nodes.name: highlight
nodes.signature: function highlight(lines: readonly string[], language: string | undefined): string[]
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of each line.

nodes.name: rustLines
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of Rust lines, with strings that carry across lines.

nodes.name: rustLine
nodes.signature: function rustLine(src: string): { html: string; open: boolean }
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of one Rust line and whether a string stays open at its end.

nodes.name: pythonLines
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of Python lines, with triple-quoted strings that carry across lines.

nodes.name: pythonLine
nodes.signature: function pythonLine(src: string): { html: string; open: string | null }
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of one Python line and the triple quote that stays open at its end.

nodes.name: typescriptLines
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of TypeScript lines, with block comments and template strings that carry across lines.

nodes.name: closeAt
nodes.signature: function closeAt(src: string, closer: Closer): number
nodes.documentation: Returns the index right after the closer of an open block comment or template string, or -1.

nodes.name: typescriptLine
nodes.signature: function typescriptLine(src: string): { html: string; open: Closer | null }
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of one TypeScript line and the closer that stays open at its end.

nodes.name: DeckModel
nodes.documentation: Everything the deck derives once from the graph and the flow. It never changes while the deck lives.

nodes.name: stepAt
nodes.documentation: The step at an index, or null at rest.

nodes.name: fnAt
nodes.documentation: The graph function of the step at an index, or null at rest and for a step function that the graph lost.

nodes.name: stepCluster
nodes.documentation: The cluster that lifts at a step, or null.

nodes.name: colorVar
nodes.documentation: Returns the CSS color of a cluster.

nodes.name: buildModel
nodes.signature: function buildModel(sourceGraph: DeckGraph, flow: DeckFlow | null, sources: ReadonlyMap<string, SourceView>): DeckModel
nodes.documentation: Derives the deck model from a graph, a flow, and the step sources.

nodes.name: withMembership
nodes.signature: function withMembership(graph: DeckGraph, flow: DeckFlow | null): DeckGraph
nodes.documentation: Returns a copy of the graph where each function carries the flow cluster that holds it.

nodes.name: DeckState
nodes.documentation: The mutable state of one deck.

nodes.name: initialState
nodes.documentation: Returns the rest state of a new deck. The path to every flow file starts open.

nodes.name: nextStep
nodes.documentation: Returns the step that forward goes to: the next step, or from the rest state the step that a clear left.

nodes.name: shownFile
nodes.signature: function shownFile(model: DeckModel, state: DeckState): { file: string; cluster: string | null; key: string | null } | null
nodes.returnType: { file: string; cluster: string | null; key: string | null } | null
nodes.documentation:
Returns the file whose box shows, with the cluster and the function that the box marks as current.
 A browsed file wins over the step and marks neither. A step with no function in the graph shows no file.

nodes.name: ortho
nodes.documentation: An orthogonal path with 4 px elbow corners.

nodes.name: guidePath
parameters: node: { left: number; top: number; height: number }
frame?: { left: number; top: number; bottom: number }
nodes.documentation:
The guide: straight across to a level file node, else one tree elbow in the gutter left of the box.
 A row outside the frame's height range puts the gutter at `max(frame.left - 8, sx + 4)`, so the guide clears the bars.
 The floor is `sx + 4`: a row that ends within 12 px of the frame puts the gutter at or inside the frame edge.

nodes.name: sCurve
nodes.signature: const sCurve = (a: { x: number; y: number }, tx: number, b: { x: number; y: number })
nodes.documentation: One S curve with level ends from a level lead-out point to the end.

nodes.name: tetherPath
nodes.signature: function tetherPath(a: { x: number; y: number }, rowsRight: number, b: { x: number; y: number }): { d: string; ok: boolean }
nodes.documentation:
The tether: level out of the slot past the widest row, then one S into the lid.
 Hidden when the lid leaves under CLEAR px for the curve past the rows: a shorter curve would cross a row.

nodes.name: arrowPath
nodes.signature: function arrowPath(a: { x: number; y: number }, deckRight: number, b: { x: number; y: number }): { d: string; head: string; ok: boolean }
nodes.returnType: { d: string; head: string; ok: boolean }
nodes.documentation: The arrow: out of the lid past the deck's right edge, then one S into the code header. Hidden under 24 px of room.

nodes.name: effectiveCluster
nodes.signature: function effectiveCluster(flow: DeckFlow, clusters: ReadonlyMap<string, DeckCluster>, index: number): string | null
nodes.documentation: Returns the cluster that lifts at a step: its labeled cluster when that cluster has a member in the graph, else null.

nodes.name: buildPlan
nodes.signature: function buildPlan(flow: DeckFlow, fileOf: (key: string) => string | undefined): FlowPlan
nodes.documentation: Builds the plan of one flow. `fileOf` returns the file of a function in the current graph.

nodes.name: runAt
nodes.documentation: Returns the run that holds a step, or null.

nodes.name: nextRunStart
nodes.documentation:
The first step of the section after the one that holds a step, or null in the last section. A section is a run.
 From the rest state it is the first section.

nodes.name: prevRunStart
nodes.signature: function prevRunStart(plan: FlowPlan, current: number): number | null
nodes.documentation: The first step of the section before the one that holds a step, or null in the first section and at rest.

nodes.name: rangesOf
nodes.documentation: Returns the step ranges of a cluster, for example "1–4, 15–20, 37".

nodes.name: nearestStep
nodes.signature: function nearestStep(plan: FlowPlan, id: string, current: number): number | null
nodes.documentation: Returns the visit of a function nearest to the current step, preferring visits in the current pass.

nodes.name: memberOrder
nodes.signature: function memberOrder(plan: FlowPlan, cluster: DeckCluster): string[]
nodes.documentation: Members in first-visit order. A member that no step visits goes last, in assignment order.

nodes.name: nextStepOfFile
nodes.signature: function nextStepOfFile(plan: FlowPlan, file: string, current: number): number | null
nodes.documentation: The file's next step after the current one, wrapping to its first, or null when the file has none.

nodes.name: transitionFact
nodes.signature: function transitionFact(transition: Transition | null, prev: string | null, cur: string): { tag: "flow start" | "gap" | null; text: string }
nodes.documentation: The sentence for the transition into the current step. The flow start and a gap also carry a tag.

nodes.name: CallRef
nodes.documentation: One name in a call list. `step` is set only for a current cluster member that is not the current step.

nodes.name: callRefs
nodes.signature:
function callRefs(keys: readonly string[], fns: ReadonlyMap<string, DeckFunction>, members: ReadonlySet<string>,
  stepOf: (key: string) => number | null, current: number): CallRef[]
nodes.documentation: Names as the graph gives them, never merged. Equal names get their file as a hint.

nodes.name: callersOf
nodes.signature: const callersOf = (key: string, calls: readonly DeckCall[])
nodes.documentation: The distinct callers of a function, in graph order.

nodes.name: calleesOf
nodes.signature: const calleesOf = (key: string, calls: readonly DeckCall[])
nodes.documentation: The distinct callees of a function, in graph order.

nodes.name: otherVisits
nodes.signature: const otherVisits = (visits: readonly number[], current: number)
nodes.documentation: The visits of the function other than the current step.

nodes.name: sourceNote
nodes.signature: function sourceNote(view: SourceView | undefined): string | null
nodes.documentation:
The note that replaces code, or null when the source can show. The text may hold `code` spans.
 An `ok` answer with no lines counts as unreadable.

nodes.name: whole
nodes.documentation: A line number or a count from the `/source` answer, as a whole number. Anything else gives the fallback.

nodes.name: lineSpan
nodes.signature: function lineSpan(range: readonly [number, number] | null | undefined, first: number, count: number): { from: number; to: number } | null
nodes.documentation:
Returns the indexes of a line range in `count` shown lines that start at line `first`, cut at the last shown line.
 Returns null when the range is not a pair of whole numbers or does not start in the shown lines.

nodes.name: oneLineSignature
nodes.documentation: A signature on one line: no space after "(", no trailing comma before ")", one space between words.

nodes.name: clamp
nodes.signature: const clamp = (v: number, a: number, b: number)

nodes.name: mono
nodes.documentation: JetBrains Mono advances 0.6 em per character, so text widths are exact.

nodes.name: showLoading
nodes.documentation: Shows one loading line with a cursor at the top of the code column, or hides it. The code viewer hides while it shows.

nodes.name: showNotice
nodes.documentation: Shows a notice at the top of the code column, or hides it. A notice stays until the next step or load.

nodes.name: showReader
nodes.documentation: Shows or hides the code header and the code viewer. They hide while no deck is loaded.

nodes.name: showShell
nodes.signature: function showShell(badge: string, color: string, desc: string, meta: string, alert = false)
nodes.documentation:
Fills the code column and empties the flow band while no deck is loaded. The chrome stays visible and inert.
 An alert text goes to screen readers at once. A deck part returns its own elements to the shell state when the deck is destroyed.

nodes.name: setChrome
nodes.documentation: Enables or disables every control that needs a deck, and dims the key help while the keys do nothing.

nodes.name: fail
nodes.documentation:
Shows a load failure in the code column, with one recovery step.
 A failure of a load that a newer load replaced is dropped: the newer load owns the page.

nodes.name: openArtifact
nodes.signature: async function openArtifact(file: string, flowName: string | null, step: number, notice: string | null = null)
nodes.documentation: Loads one codebase, verifies its graph, and opens the requested flow. A failure shows unless a newer load started.

nodes.name: openFlow
nodes.signature: async function openFlow(next: FlowEntry | null, step: number, notice: string | null = null)
nodes.documentation:
Loads one flow of the current codebase and the source of its step functions, then replaces the deck.
 A failed source load still plays the flow: every code viewer shows the unreadable note.

nodes.name: openPicker
nodes.documentation: Opens the codebase or flow list under its badge.

nodes.name: badgeHtml
nodes.signature: function badgeHtml(id: string, cls: string, inner: string, label: string | null): string
nodes.documentation: A name badge: a button that opens a picker when `label` is set, else a plain label. `inner` is escaped markup.

nodes.name: renderRepoBadge
nodes.documentation: The codebase badge: a picker when the index holds more than one codebase.

nodes.name: nameTab
nodes.documentation: Names the browser tab after the step, the flow, and the codebase.

nodes.name: renderFlowBand
nodes.documentation:
The flow badge and its freshness in the top band, or an empty band without a flow, and the page heading.
 The badge is a picker when the codebase has more than one flow.

nodes.name: mockHelp
nodes.documentation: The help line names the mockup keys after the viewer's own keys.

nodes.name: offFlowHtml
nodes.documentation: Lists the changed files that no flow step reaches, grouped by kind, with their line counts.

nodes.name: boxWidth
nodes.signature: const boxWidth = (name, file, steps, away, glyph)

nodes.name: boxWidth
nodes.signature: const boxWidth = (name, file, steps, away, glyph)

nodes.name: boxWidth
nodes.signature: const boxWidth = (name, file, steps, away, glyph)

nodes.name: hit
nodes.signature: const hit = (conn, name, pts, rects, k)

nodes.name: displayName
nodes.signature: function displayName(key: string, fallback: string): string
nodes.documentation: Returns the display name of a callable: the key segments after the path, without kind prefixes.

nodes.name: deckGraph
nodes.documentation:
Builds the deck graph from a verified graph document.
 Files come from module nodes and callable paths. Functions keep source order in each file.
 Calls are the distinct `calls` edges between two different callables.

nodes.name: fileTree
nodes.documentation: Builds the directory tree. In each directory, files come first, then subdirectories, each in name order.

nodes.name: deckFlow
nodes.signature: function deckFlow(artifact: FlowArtifact, graph: DeckGraph, graphDigest: string, entry: FlowEntry | null = null): DeckFlow
nodes.documentation:
Adapts a frozen schema 4 flow artifact.
 Clusters keep intent order. Members come from assigned member decisions that the graph contains.
 A step with no cluster label joins no deck; release 1 artifacts always carry a label.

nodes.name: frozenFlows
nodes.documentation: Returns the flows that the viewer shows: the frozen schema 4 entries of a codebase, in index order.

nodes.name: pickFlow
nodes.signature: function pickFlow(flows: readonly FlowEntry[], requested: string | null): FlowEntry | null
nodes.documentation: Picks the flow to open: the requested name, else the first flow.

nodes.name: bindingDigest
nodes.documentation: Returns the graph file digest that flows of a codebase bind. A server without `graphDigest` serves the file as it is.

nodes.name: pickArtifact
nodes.signature: function pickArtifact(index: ArtifactIndex, requested: string | null): ArtifactEntry | null
nodes.documentation: Picks the codebase to open: the requested file, else the index default, else the first codebase.

nodes.name: resolveLink
nodes.signature:
function resolveLink(index: ArtifactIndex, want: { artifact: string | null; flow: string | null; step: number }):
  { file: string; flow: string | null; step: number; notice: string | null } | null
parameters: want: { artifact: string | null; flow: string | null; step: number }
nodes.returnType: { file: string; flow: string | null; step: number; notice: string | null } | null
nodes.documentation:
Resolves the codebase, flow, and step of a page link. A missing name opens the fallback at step 0 with a notice.
 A missing codebase also drops the flow of the link, because that flow belongs to the missing codebase.
 A step past the end of the flow opens its last step with a notice.

nodes.name: LoadError
nodes.documentation: A load failure with its cause.

nodes.name: fetchOk
nodes.signature: async function fetchOk(url: string, what: string): Promise<Response>
nodes.documentation: Fetches one URL. No answer is a `fetch` failure; an HTTP error is a `server` failure.

nodes.name: fetchJson
nodes.signature: async function fetchJson<T>(url: string, what: string, reason: LoadReason): Promise<T>
nodes.documentation: Fetches and parses one JSON answer. An answer that is not JSON is a failure with the caller's reason.

nodes.name: loadIndex
nodes.documentation: Loads the artifact index. An index with no codebase is an `empty` failure.

nodes.name: digestOf
nodes.documentation: Returns the `sha256:<hex>` digest of the bytes.

nodes.name: verifyGraph
nodes.signature: async function verifyGraph(bytes: ArrayBuffer, entry: Pick<ArtifactEntry, "file" | "digest">): Promise<GraphDocument>
nodes.documentation:
Checks graph bytes against the index digest before any graph fact is used, then parses them.
 A digest mismatch is a `digest` failure; a document that is not a schema 1 graph is a `graph` failure.

nodes.name: loadGraph
nodes.documentation: Loads and verifies the graph file of one codebase.

nodes.name: loadFlow
nodes.documentation: Loads the frozen generation that an index entry points to. The adapter checks its shape.

nodes.name: loadDiff
nodes.signature: async function loadDiff(index: ArtifactIndex, name: string): Promise<DiffArtifact>
nodes.documentation:
Loads one frozen PR diff. The index entry names its file; without an entry the store default `diffs/<name>.json` applies.
 A document that is not a schema 1 diff is a `diff` failure.

nodes.name: validRow
nodes.documentation: True when a row has only the kinds, counts, spans, and line ops of the schema. The view puts these values in markup without escapes.

nodes.name: loadSource
nodes.signature: async function loadSource(artifact: string, flow: string): Promise<Map<string, SourceView>>
nodes.documentation: Loads the source of every step function of one flow. The server cuts it from the project files.

nodes.name: FlowEntry
nodes.documentation: One flow in the artifact index. `file` points to a frozen schema 4 generation under `flows/`.

nodes.name: ArtifactEntry
nodes.documentation:
One indexed codebase. `digest` names the graph document that the server sends, with its cached semantic edges;
 `graphDigest` names the graph file that flows bind. An older server sends no `graphDigest`: the two are the same.

nodes.name: DiffEntry
nodes.documentation: One frozen PR diff in the artifact index. `file` is relative to the store, for example `diffs/<name>.json`.

nodes.name: ArtifactIndex
nodes.documentation: The artifact index that the viewer server returns.

nodes.name: GraphNode
nodes.documentation: The fields of one graph node that the viewer reads.

nodes.name: GraphEdge
nodes.documentation: The fields of one graph edge that the viewer reads.

nodes.name: GraphDocument
nodes.documentation: A schema 1 graph document, after its digest check.

nodes.name: StepLedger
nodes.documentation: The step text: one row for each used slot, in display order. A null slot is not used. Items hold marks.

nodes.name: FlowArtifact
nodes.documentation: The fields of a frozen schema 4 flow artifact that the viewer reads.

nodes.name: facts
nodes.declaredType: { binding: { graphDigest: string }; nodes: { key: string; signature?: string | null; documentation?: string | null }[] }

nodes.name: intent
assignment
nodes.declaredType: { members: { outcome: string; nodeKey: string; clusterKey?: string }[] }

nodes.name: view
nodes.declaredType: { clusters: { clusterKey: string; color: string }[]; steps: { stepId: string; transition: Transition }[] }

nodes.name: LineSpan
nodes.documentation: Lines `start` to `end` of one file, counted from 1, both included.

nodes.name: DiffLine
nodes.documentation: One line of a unified diff.

nodes.name: DiffRow
nodes.documentation: The derived facts of one After step, of one pair, or of one removed Before step.

nodes.name: DiffNote
nodes.documentation: The note of one cluster on one side: what its code does differently.

nodes.name: DiffArtifact
nodes.documentation: A frozen schema 1 PR diff. `rows` holds the After steps in flow order, then the removed Before steps.

nodes.name: DeckFunction
nodes.documentation: One callable from the indexed graph. `cluster` is the flow cluster that holds it, or null.

nodes.name: DeckCall
nodes.documentation: One static call relationship in the source, caller first. It is not a runtime count.

nodes.name: DeckTree
nodes.documentation: Directory tree: a key that ends with "/" is a directory; any other key is a file.

nodes.name: DeckGraph
nodes.documentation: Source facts that the deck shows, independent of any flow.

nodes.name: DeckCluster
nodes.documentation: One cluster. `phase` is the readable stage name. `input` and `output` name data models; empty means none.

nodes.name: DeckStep
nodes.documentation: One flow step. `missing` is true when the bound graph no longer has the step function.

nodes.name: DeckFlow
nodes.documentation: One playable flow. `stale` is true when the flow was frozen against another graph digest.

nodes.name: SourceView
nodes.documentation: The source of one step function, as the `/source` route answers it. Line numbers are one-based.

nodes.name: SourceDocument
nodes.documentation: The `/source` answer for one flow.

nodes.name: showTip
nodes.documentation: Names the step of a cell in the tip above the bar.

nodes.name: clusterLedger
nodes.documentation: The cluster as ledger rows: its phase with the data models that enter and leave, then its rules.

nodes.name: BoxView
nodes.documentation: One lifted box and the elements that the deck reads.

nodes.name: DeckView
nodes.documentation: The deck of one cluster.

nodes.name: setBox
nodes.signature: const setBox = (el: HTMLElement, x: number, y: number, z: number)
nodes.documentation: Puts a box at a deck-plane place and a height.

nodes.name: makeBox
nodes.signature: function makeBox(key: string, cluster: ClusterView): BoxView
nodes.documentation: Builds the lifted box of one member.

nodes.name: createDeck
nodes.documentation: Builds the deck of a cluster, raised, with every box at its final place. `pin` puts it on screen.

nodes.name: sinkDeck
nodes.documentation: Removes the current deck at once.

nodes.name: mark
nodes.documentation: Marks the current box and shows a file path on the boxes that live in other files.

nodes.name: title
nodes.documentation: The header title with its cursor. A step title starts with the step number for screen readers; the badge shows it on screen.

nodes.name: noteHtml
nodes.documentation: The note that replaces code. It may hold `code` spans.

nodes.name: whereHtml
nodes.signature: function whereHtml(path: string, line: number | null): string
nodes.documentation: The code header path: the folder dimmed, then the declaration line in orange when the code shows.

nodes.name: refList
nodes.documentation: A call list: names as the graph gives them, file hints dimmed, never merged. A current cluster member takes its color and goes to its step.

nodes.name: fitFold
nodes.documentation: Shows the fold button when the step details overflow the top half, or are folded.

nodes.name: setFold
nodes.documentation: Hides or shows the step details under the step title.

nodes.name: renderEmpty
nodes.documentation:
The rest state, or the state of a codebase with no flow. After a clear, the rest state names the step that forward continues at.
 The code header hides: it has no path and nothing to show full screen.

nodes.name: nameOf
nodes.documentation: The display name of a step function, also when the graph no longer has it.

nodes.name: fromFact
nodes.documentation: The "from" fact: the flow start tag, or the transition from the previous step. Null when the flow gives no transition.

nodes.name: callFacts
nodes.documentation: The call lists and the other visits of the current step function.

nodes.name: renderCode
nodes.signature: function renderCode(view: SourceView, lines: readonly string[]): { doc: boolean; sig: boolean }
nodes.documentation: Draws the lines of an `ok` source and returns the margin marks that it drew. It lands on the declaration.

nodes.name: mark
nodes.signature: const mark = (range: readonly [number, number] | null | undefined, name: "doc" | "signature"): boolean
nodes.documentation: Draws one margin mark over a line range. Returns false when the range is not in the lines.

nodes.name: swap
nodes.documentation: Restarts the fade of the step text and the code on a step change, except at boot. The CSS stops it under reduced motion.

nodes.name: pageOrigin
nodes.signature: function pageOrigin(): { x: number; y: number }
nodes.documentation: The screen position of the page origin. The fixed panels are placed from it, because the page scrolls in a small window.

nodes.name: Explorer
nodes.documentation: Created by `explorer.ts`.

nodes.name: sync
nodes.documentation: Marks the current file, the current cluster's files, and the open state in the rows.

nodes.name: reveal
nodes.documentation: Scrolls a long tree so the current file's row sits inside the canvas frame's height.

nodes.name: anchorEl
nodes.documentation: The row element that the guide starts from, or null when no file shows.

nodes.name: FileBoxView
nodes.documentation: Created by `file-box.ts`.

nodes.name: height
nodes.documentation: The height of the shown box, from its top edge to the bottom of its last row.

nodes.name: slotEl
nodes.documentation: The current function's row node, or null when no row is current.

nodes.name: rowsRight
nodes.documentation: The largest right edge of the rows on screen.

nodes.name: ClusterDeck
nodes.documentation: Created by `cluster-deck.ts`.

nodes.name: show
nodes.documentation: Replaces the deck with the deck of a cluster, already raised, or removes it for null.

nodes.name: mark
nodes.documentation: Marks the current box and shows the file path on the boxes of other files.

nodes.name: pin
nodes.signature: pin(spot: { x: number; y: number }, anchor: { x: number; y: number }, k: number): void
nodes.documentation: Puts the deck at its screen spot while the canvas scales by k around the anchor.

nodes.name: currentLid
nodes.documentation: The lid of the current step's box, or null when the deck has none.

nodes.name: deckRight
nodes.documentation: The right edge of the deck's title band, or 0 without a deck.

nodes.name: Links
nodes.documentation: Created by `links.ts`.

nodes.name: CodeColumn
nodes.documentation: Declared here and created by `code.ts`.

nodes.name: Bar
nodes.documentation: Declared here and created by `bar.ts`.

nodes.name: Tools
nodes.documentation: Declared here and created by `tools.ts`.

nodes.name: DeckParts
nodes.documentation: The deck modules. `deck.ts` fills this object after it creates every module.

nodes.name: CodeView
nodes.documentation:
A replacement for the code viewer of one step: the code header markup, the code markup, and a tag before the
 annotation. The line marked `data-land` is where the viewer scrolls to.

nodes.name: DeckOptions
nodes.documentation: Options that the page gives a deck.

nodes.name: DeckContext
nodes.documentation: The shared context of one deck.

nodes.name: go
nodes.documentation: Goes to a step.

nodes.name: place
nodes.documentation: Places the file box and the deck, then draws the connectors.

nodes.name: placeSoon
nodes.documentation: Lays out the top band and places the deck on the next frame, once for every call in that frame.

nodes.name: rectOf
nodes.documentation: Returns the screen rectangle of an element, or null.

nodes.name: createDeck
nodes.documentation: Creates the deck for one codebase and one flow in the page shell.

nodes.name: go
nodes.documentation: Goes to a step. A step clears a browsed file, also when the step does not change. A clear keeps its step for forward.

nodes.name: render
nodes.documentation: Shows the current step in every part. `prev` is the step before it.

nodes.name: place
nodes.documentation:
Places the file box and the deck, then draws the connectors. A browsed file shows without a deck.
 Returns the start zoom of the frame that it measured.

nodes.name: pathOf
nodes.documentation: The `d` attribute of a connector path, or null when the connector is hidden.

nodes.name: RowView
nodes.documentation: A row and the elements that show it, or null elements until the row first shows.

nodes.name: guides
nodes.documentation: Returns the tree guide cells of a row, or "" for a row at the top level.

nodes.name: nameHtml
nodes.documentation: The name of a row: the head cuts with an ellipsis, and the last characters stay whole.

nodes.name: build
nodes.documentation: Builds the element of one row. The first row holds the tree's tab stop.

nodes.name: moveStop
nodes.signature: function moveStop(from: HTMLElement, to: HTMLElement, focus: boolean)
nodes.documentation: Moves the tree's one tab stop from a row to another, and the focus with it when `focus` is set.

nodes.name: anchorEl
nodes.documentation: The element of the current file's row, or of its nearest shown directory.

nodes.name: openFile
nodes.documentation: A file click goes to its next flow step, from the current step on. At rest, or for a file with no step, it shows the file box.

nodes.name: render
nodes.documentation: Draws the box of the shown file, or hides it when no file shows.

nodes.name: typing
nodes.documentation: True when a key goes to a text field.

nodes.name: createInput
nodes.documentation:
Listens for the deck keys until the deck's signal aborts.
 j and Left go back, k and Right go forward; neither wraps. Forward from the rest state continues at the step that a clear left.
 h and l go to the first step of the previous and the next section, where the cluster changes.
 Escape closes the key, then leaves full screen, then clears the flow.

nodes.name: hideAll
nodes.documentation: Hides every connector.

nodes.name: inFrame
nodes.signature: const inFrame = (p: { x: number; y: number }, fr: DOMRect)
nodes.documentation: True when a screen point lies inside the frame's rectangle.

nodes.name: drawGuide
nodes.documentation: Draws the guide from the end of the explorer row straight across to the file node.

nodes.name: drawTether
nodes.signature: function drawTether(lid: HTMLElement | null, fr: DOMRect): boolean
nodes.documentation: Draws the tether from the current slot to the current lid, level out past the widest row, then one S curve.

nodes.name: drawArrow
nodes.signature: function drawArrow(lid: HTMLElement | null, fr: DOMRect): boolean
nodes.documentation: Draws the arrow from the current lid out past the deck's edge, then one S curve into the code header.

nodes.name: md
nodes.documentation: Escapes text, then turns `x` into x and **x** into x.

nodes.name: chip
nodes.documentation: Returns one identifier chip.

nodes.name: marks
nodes.documentation: Escapes one ledger line and turns each `kind:name` mark into a chip. A span without a known kind stays inline code.

nodes.name: ledgerRows
nodes.signature: function ledgerRows(rows: readonly (readonly [string, readonly string[] | null])[], lead = ""): string
nodes.documentation:
Renders label rows. A row with one item reads inline; a row with more items is a bullet list. Empty rows drop out.
 `lead` goes before the first value.

nodes.name: ledgerHtml
nodes.documentation: Renders a step ledger in slot order.

nodes.name: flowPicker
nodes.signature: function flowPicker(flows: readonly FlowEntry[], current: string | null): string
nodes.documentation: The flow list of one codebase.

nodes.name: codebasePicker
nodes.signature: function codebasePicker(artifacts: readonly ArtifactEntry[], current: string | null, flowCount: (entry: ArtifactEntry) => number): string
nodes.documentation: The list of indexed codebases. `flowCount` counts the flows that the viewer shows.

nodes.name: scrollPageTo
nodes.signature: function scrollPageTo(r: { left: number; top: number; right: number; bottom: number })
parameters: r: { left: number; top: number; right: number; bottom: number }
nodes.documentation: Scrolls the page, never the body, until a screen box shows in the window: a scrolled small window can hide the map tools.

nodes.name: setKey
nodes.documentation:
Opens or closes the key. With `moveFocus`, an open moves the focus into the key and a close returns it to the key button.
 A close also returns the focus that was inside the key, so it never falls to the page.

nodes.name: setVariant
nodes.signature: function setVariant(v: string | null, save: boolean)

nodes.name: sync
nodes.documentation:
Shows the compact state, the zoom level and its limits, and the current cluster in the key.
 Compact is off at rest. Compact and zoom are off in full screen, where the map does not show.

nodes.name: setZoom
nodes.signature: function setZoom(k: number, at?: { x: number; y: number })
nodes.documentation:
Sets the user's zoom, from 50% to 150%. The map point at `at` (the frame's center by default) stays put on screen:
 past the fit the map grows from the frame's top left corner, so the pan moves by the growth before that point.

nodes.name: toggleCompact
nodes.documentation: Stubs or names the functions off the flow. Compact starts on at every load; nothing stores it.

nodes.name: pans
nodes.documentation: True when a move by a screen delta changes the pan; at its limit a scroll goes to the page instead.

nodes.name: showFull
nodes.documentation: Sets the page class and the full screen button for one mode. The button names its key while the shortcuts are on.

nodes.name: setFull
nodes.documentation:
Shows the code full screen over the canvas with no connectors, or returns to the canvas with its connectors drawn at once.
 At rest there is no code, so full screen does not open.

nodes.name: layoutTop
nodes.documentation: Puts the flow band right of the map tools, and the canvas frame below both.

nodes.name: SideStep
nodes.documentation: One step of one side. `index` counts from 1 in that side's flow order. `row` is null for an unchanged step that the diff has no row for.

nodes.name: Run
nodes.documentation: Consecutive steps of one side with the same cluster.

nodes.name: OverviewRow
nodes.documentation:
One overview row: a Before run, an After run, or both. `continues` marks an After run whose label came before.
 `entry` is the After step that the deck opens for the row.

nodes.name: rowOfAfter
nodes.documentation: The row whose After run holds an After step index, or -1.

nodes.name: afterOf
nodes.documentation: The After step that a Before step became, or null for a removed step.

nodes.name: movedText
nodes.signature: function movedText(row: DiffRow | null): string | null
nodes.documentation: Returns the moved-file text of a moved step, or null.

nodes.name: buildDiffModel
nodes.documentation: Derives the diff model. A step that the diff has no row for is unchanged. A Before step takes the kind of its pair.

nodes.name: sideSteps
nodes.signature: function sideSteps(flow: FlowArtifact, side: Side, rows: ReadonlyMap<string, DiffRow>): SideStep[]

nodes.name: counted
nodes.signature: const counted = (kind: ChangeKind): kind is Counted

nodes.name: runsOf
nodes.signature: function runsOf(steps: readonly SideStep[], flow: FlowArtifact): Run[]
nodes.documentation: Splits the steps of one side into runs of the same cluster. A step with no cluster forms runs of its own.

nodes.name: alignRuns
nodes.signature: function alignRuns(b: readonly Run[], a: readonly Run[]): { before: Run | null; after: Run | null }[]
nodes.returnType: { before: Run | null; after: Run | null }[]
nodes.documentation: Puts Before runs and After runs in one row list: runs with the same label share a row (longest common subsequence).

nodes.name: describeRow
nodes.signature: function describeRow(b: Run | null, a: Run | null, notes: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, afterOf: (step: SideStep) => SideStep | null): OverviewRow
nodes.documentation:
Counts the changed steps and lines of one row. The After run counts its new, changed, and moved steps; the Before run
 counts its removed steps. Two steps that show the same function count its lines once.

nodes.name: note
nodes.signature: const note = (side: Side, run: Run | null)

nodes.name: Slot
nodes.documentation: One line of an open row: a Before step and an After step that are the same step, or one of them alone.

nodes.name: slotsOf
nodes.signature: function slotsOf(model: DiffModel, row: OverviewRow): Slot[]
nodes.documentation: Matches the Before steps and the After steps of one row by the agent pairs, in flow order.

nodes.name: lcs
nodes.signature: function lcs<B, A>(b: readonly B[], a: readonly A[], match: (x: B, y: A) => boolean): [B | null, A | null][]
nodes.documentation: Aligns two lists by the longest common subsequence of a match. Unmatched items get a null partner, in list order.

nodes.name: NumberedLine
nodes.documentation: One numbered diff line. `no` is the new line number, or the old one for a removed line.

nodes.name: numberLines
nodes.documentation:
Numbers the lines of one step diff. A context line moves both counters, a removed line the old one, and an added line
 the new one. The old counter starts at the base span, the new counter at the head span.

nodes.name: sync
nodes.documentation: Shows the overview at step 0 and the deck at every other step.

nodes.name: codeView
nodes.documentation: The step diff that replaces the source in the code column.

nodes.name: band
nodes.documentation: Adds the overview button to the flow band of the deck.

nodes.name: fit
nodes.documentation: JetBrains Mono advances 0.6 em: the characters that fit a width at a font size.

nodes.name: delta
nodes.documentation: The +added −removed line delta, each number in its git color.

nodes.name: languageOf
nodes.signature: function languageOf(path: string | undefined): string | undefined
nodes.documentation: The language of a path for the highlighter, or undefined for plain text.

nodes.name: createDiffView
nodes.signature: function createDiffView(diff: DiffArtifact, go: (step: number) => void): DiffView

nodes.name: summary
nodes.documentation: One sentence of step facts.

nodes.name: slotsOfOpen
nodes.documentation: The step slots of an open row, and the height of a slot: a moved-file line makes it tall on both sides.

nodes.name: draw
nodes.documentation: Draws the diagram: the side frames, the flow arrows between rows, the rows, and the numbers.

nodes.name: chevron
nodes.signature: function chevron(row: OverviewRow, i: number, side: Side, x: number, y: number, isOpen: boolean)
nodes.documentation: A chevron that opens or closes the row.

nodes.name: bars
nodes.documentation: A closed row: one neutral bar for each side that has a run.

nodes.name: openRow
nodes.documentation: An open row: a neutral frame for each side, its step count in the title bar, and one line for each step slot.

nodes.name: stepNode
nodes.signature: function stepNode(step: SideStep, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, moved: boolean)
nodes.documentation: One step node in an open row: the name at left, the line delta at right, and the moved-file line under the name.

nodes.name: stats
nodes.documentation:
The numbers of one row, centered on its title line: the changed steps (two kinds a line), then the line delta.
 A row with no changed step shows nothing.

nodes.name: reveal
nodes.documentation: Scrolls the overview body so that an element shows. The page and the band never move.

nodes.name: markSel
nodes.documentation: Rings the current row in blue, on its After bar when it has one.

nodes.name: toggle
nodes.documentation: Opens or closes one row. One row stays open at a time.

nodes.name: showTip
nodes.documentation: Shows the note of a row in the numbers column, centered on its title line. The side under the pointer comes first.

nodes.name: showRemoved
nodes.documentation: Shows a removed step in the code column. The deck stays at its step; the next step replaces this view.

nodes.name: diffCode
nodes.documentation:
The step diff for the code column: path:line and the line delta in the header, then the unified diff with
 +/− marks and line numbers. The view lands on the first changed line.

nodes.name: overviewBar
nodes.documentation: The bar text on the overview. It runs after the deck renders its rest state.

nodes.name: lidPathLength
nodes.documentation:
The characters of a file path that a lid makes room for: "…/" and the file name, or a shorter whole path.
 The lid cuts a longer path from its start, so the deck stays narrow and the file name shows.

nodes.name: boxWidth
nodes.signature: const boxWidth = (name: string, file: string, steps: readonly number[], away: boolean)
nodes.documentation: The width of a lifted box: its name (or the end of its file path when it lives in another file) and its step numbers.

nodes.name: deckSize
nodes.signature: function deckSize(clusters: readonly (readonly { name: string; file: string; steps: readonly number[] }[])[]): { width: number; maxHeight: number }
parameters: clusters: readonly (readonly { name: string; file: string; steps: readonly number[] }[])[]
nodes.documentation: One width and the tallest height over every cluster, so the pinned deck never changes width and always fits.

nodes.name: home
nodes.documentation: The deck-plane place of the i-th box.

nodes.name: deckDepth
nodes.documentation: The deck's screen height at 100%: from its raised top edge down to its cast shadow.

nodes.name: deckSpot
nodes.signature: function deckSpot(frame: Frame, codeLeft: number, deckWidth: number, maxHeight: number, k: number): { x: number; y: number }
nodes.documentation: The pinned deck spot on screen at zoom k. The right edge and the top edge stay put; the deck grows left and down.

nodes.name: fileRoom
nodes.signature: const fileRoom = (frameLeft: number, deckLeft: number, k: number)
nodes.documentation: The room for the file box rows left of the deck, in box pixels from the box's left edge.

nodes.name: deckTransform
nodes.signature: const deckTransform = (spot: { x: number; y: number }, anchor: { x: number; y: number }, k: number)
nodes.documentation: The deck's CSS transform inside the canvas, which scales by k around the anchor, so the deck stays at its spot.

nodes.name: fileBoxCenter
nodes.signature: function fileBoxCenter(rowY: number, frame: Frame, fileHeight: number, k: number): number
nodes.documentation:
The screen y of the file node's center: level with its explorer row, unless the box would leave the frame.
 The box top sits 10 box px above the node's center.

nodes.name: roomOf
nodes.documentation: The room for the file box and the deck at 100%, between the file box's left edge and the deck's pinned right edge.

nodes.name: zoomFit
nodes.signature: function zoomFit(frame: Frame, codeLeft: number, deck: { width: number; maxHeight: number }, fileRight: number, fileMin: number): { start: number; max: number; wide: number }
nodes.returnType: { start: number; max: number; wide: number }
nodes.documentation:
The zoom range of a frame. `wide` is the largest zoom at which the widest flow file box (`fileRight`) ends CLEAR px
 before the deck, but not under the floor: there the names end in an ellipsis. The floor gives way where even the
 narrowest rows (`fileMin`) would reach the deck. `max` is `wide` lowered to where the deck fits the frame height:
 the largest zoom that shows the whole map. `start` is that fit in 10% steps, from the floor to 100%.

nodes.name: deckShift
nodes.signature: const deckShift = (frame: Frame, codeLeft: number, wide: number, k: number)
nodes.documentation:
How far the deck moves right of its pinned spot at zoom k. Past the width fit `wide` the map grows as it does at the fit,
 so the rows keep their room before the deck, and the deck leaves the frame on the right.

nodes.name: deckBelow
nodes.signature: const deckBelow = (frameHeight: number, maxHeight: number, k: number)
nodes.documentation: How far the deck reaches below the frame at zoom k, 4 px inside its edge, where the deck no longer fits its height.

nodes.name: ExplorerRow
nodes.documentation:
One explorer row. A directory path ends with "/". `files` holds every file at or under the row.
 `pos` is the row's place among its `size` siblings, from 1.

nodes.name: buildExplorer
nodes.documentation: Builds the rows in tree order. The tree already lists files before subdirectories, each in name order.

nodes.name: walk
nodes.signature: const walk = (node: DeckTree, path: string, parent: ExplorerRow | null, depth: number): string[]

nodes.name: guideKinds
nodes.documentation: One cell per ancestor below the root (pipe or gap), then a tee or a rounded end for the row itself.

nodes.name: openTo
nodes.documentation: Opens every directory above a row.

nodes.name: isShown
nodes.signature: function isShown(row: ExplorerRow, open: ReadonlySet<string>): boolean
nodes.documentation: True when every directory above the row is open.

nodes.name: anchorRow
nodes.signature: function anchorRow(row: ExplorerRow, open: ReadonlySet<string>): ExplorerRow
nodes.documentation: Returns the row, or its nearest shown directory when a closed directory holds it.

nodes.name: dirNote
nodes.documentation: Returns the note of a closed directory ("+3 files"), or "" for an open one or a file.

nodes.name: fileBox
nodes.documentation: Lays out the rows of one file for one step.

nodes.name: span
nodes.signature: const span = (cls: string, s: string): string

nodes.name: highlight
nodes.signature: function highlight(lines: readonly string[], language: string | undefined): string[]
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of each line.

nodes.name: rustLines
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of Rust lines, with strings that carry across lines.

nodes.name: rustLine
nodes.signature: function rustLine(src: string): { html: string; open: boolean }
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of one Rust line and whether a string stays open at its end.

nodes.name: pythonLines
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of Python lines, with triple-quoted strings that carry across lines.

nodes.name: pythonLine
nodes.signature: function pythonLine(src: string): { html: string; open: string | null }
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of one Python line and the triple quote that stays open at its end.

nodes.name: typescriptLines
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of TypeScript lines, with block comments and template strings that carry across lines.

nodes.name: closeAt
nodes.signature: function closeAt(src: string, closer: Closer): number
nodes.documentation: Returns the index right after the closer of an open block comment or template string, or -1.

nodes.name: typescriptLine
nodes.signature: function typescriptLine(src: string): { html: string; open: Closer | null }
nodes.documentation: Returns the colored HTML of one TypeScript line and the closer that stays open at its end.

nodes.name: DeckModel
nodes.documentation: Everything the deck derives once from the graph and the flow. It never changes while the deck lives.

nodes.name: stepAt
nodes.documentation: The step at an index, or null at rest.

nodes.name: fnAt
nodes.documentation: The graph function of the step at an index, or null at rest and for a step function that the graph lost.

nodes.name: stepCluster
nodes.documentation: The cluster that lifts at a step, or null.

nodes.name: colorVar
nodes.documentation: Returns the CSS color of a cluster.

nodes.name: buildModel
nodes.signature: function buildModel(sourceGraph: DeckGraph, flow: DeckFlow | null, sources: ReadonlyMap<string, SourceView>): DeckModel
nodes.documentation: Derives the deck model from a graph, a flow, and the step sources.

nodes.name: withMembership
nodes.signature: function withMembership(graph: DeckGraph, flow: DeckFlow | null): DeckGraph
nodes.documentation: Returns a copy of the graph where each function carries the flow cluster that holds it.

nodes.name: DeckState
nodes.documentation: The mutable state of one deck.

nodes.name: initialState
nodes.documentation: Returns the rest state of a new deck. The path to every flow file starts open.

nodes.name: nextStep
nodes.documentation: Returns the step that forward goes to: the next step, or from the rest state the step that a clear left.

nodes.name: shownFile
nodes.signature: function shownFile(model: DeckModel, state: DeckState): { file: string; cluster: string | null; key: string | null } | null
nodes.returnType: { file: string; cluster: string | null; key: string | null } | null
nodes.documentation:
Returns the file whose box shows, with the cluster and the function that the box marks as current.
 A browsed file wins over the step and marks neither. A step with no function in the graph shows no file.

nodes.name: ortho
nodes.documentation: An orthogonal path with 4 px elbow corners.

nodes.name: guidePath
parameters: node: { left: number; top: number; height: number }
frame?: { left: number; top: number; bottom: number }
nodes.documentation:
The guide: straight across to a level file node, else one tree elbow in the gutter left of the box.
 A row outside the frame's height range puts the gutter at `max(frame.left - 8, sx + 4)`, so the guide clears the bars.
 The floor is `sx + 4`: a row that ends within 12 px of the frame puts the gutter at or inside the frame edge.

nodes.name: sCurve
nodes.signature: const sCurve = (a: { x: number; y: number }, tx: number, b: { x: number; y: number })
nodes.documentation: One S curve with level ends from a level lead-out point to the end.

nodes.name: tetherPath
nodes.signature: function tetherPath(a: { x: number; y: number }, rowsRight: number, b: { x: number; y: number }): { d: string; ok: boolean }
nodes.documentation:
The tether: level out of the slot past the widest row, then one S into the lid.
 Hidden when the lid leaves under CLEAR px for the curve past the rows: a shorter curve would cross a row.

nodes.name: arrowPath
nodes.signature: function arrowPath(a: { x: number; y: number }, deckRight: number, b: { x: number; y: number }): { d: string; head: string; ok: boolean }
nodes.returnType: { d: string; head: string; ok: boolean }
nodes.documentation: The arrow: out of the lid past the deck's right edge, then one S into the code header. Hidden under 24 px of room.

nodes.name: effectiveCluster
nodes.signature: function effectiveCluster(flow: DeckFlow, clusters: ReadonlyMap<string, DeckCluster>, index: number): string | null
nodes.documentation: Returns the cluster that lifts at a step: its labeled cluster when that cluster has a member in the graph, else null.

nodes.name: buildPlan
nodes.signature: function buildPlan(flow: DeckFlow, fileOf: (key: string) => string | undefined): FlowPlan
nodes.documentation: Builds the plan of one flow. `fileOf` returns the file of a function in the current graph.

nodes.name: runAt
nodes.documentation: Returns the run that holds a step, or null.

nodes.name: nextRunStart
nodes.documentation:
The first step of the section after the one that holds a step, or null in the last section. A section is a run.
 From the rest state it is the first section.

nodes.name: prevRunStart
nodes.signature: function prevRunStart(plan: FlowPlan, current: number): number | null
nodes.documentation: The first step of the section before the one that holds a step, or null in the first section and at rest.

nodes.name: rangesOf
nodes.documentation: Returns the step ranges of a cluster, for example "1–4, 15–20, 37".

nodes.name: nearestStep
nodes.signature: function nearestStep(plan: FlowPlan, id: string, current: number): number | null
nodes.documentation: Returns the visit of a function nearest to the current step, preferring visits in the current pass.

nodes.name: memberOrder
nodes.signature: function memberOrder(plan: FlowPlan, cluster: DeckCluster): string[]
nodes.documentation: Members in first-visit order. A member that no step visits goes last, in assignment order.

nodes.name: nextStepOfFile
nodes.signature: function nextStepOfFile(plan: FlowPlan, file: string, current: number): number | null
nodes.documentation: The file's next step after the current one, wrapping to its first, or null when the file has none.

nodes.name: transitionFact
nodes.signature: function transitionFact(transition: Transition | null, prev: string | null, cur: string): { tag: "flow start" | "gap" | null; text: string }
nodes.documentation: The sentence for the transition into the current step. The flow start and a gap also carry a tag.

nodes.name: CallRef
nodes.documentation: One name in a call list. `step` is set only for a current cluster member that is not the current step.

nodes.name: callRefs
nodes.signature:
function callRefs(keys: readonly string[], fns: ReadonlyMap<string, DeckFunction>, members: ReadonlySet<string>,
  stepOf: (key: string) => number | null, current: number): CallRef[]
nodes.documentation: Names as the graph gives them, never merged. Equal names get their file as a hint.

nodes.name: callersOf
nodes.signature: const callersOf = (key: string, calls: readonly DeckCall[])
nodes.documentation: The distinct callers of a function, in graph order.

nodes.name: calleesOf
nodes.signature: const calleesOf = (key: string, calls: readonly DeckCall[])
nodes.documentation: The distinct callees of a function, in graph order.

nodes.name: otherVisits
nodes.signature: const otherVisits = (visits: readonly number[], current: number)
nodes.documentation: The visits of the function other than the current step.

nodes.name: sourceNote
nodes.signature: function sourceNote(view: SourceView | undefined): string | null
nodes.documentation:
The note that replaces code, or null when the source can show. The text may hold `code` spans.
 An `ok` answer with no lines counts as unreadable.

nodes.name: whole
nodes.documentation: A line number or a count from the `/source` answer, as a whole number. Anything else gives the fallback.

nodes.name: lineSpan
nodes.signature: function lineSpan(range: readonly [number, number] | null | undefined, first: number, count: number): { from: number; to: number } | null
nodes.documentation:
Returns the indexes of a line range in `count` shown lines that start at line `first`, cut at the last shown line.
 Returns null when the range is not a pair of whole numbers or does not start in the shown lines.

nodes.name: oneLineSignature
nodes.documentation: A signature on one line: no space after "(", no trailing comma before ")", one space between words.

nodes.name: clamp
nodes.signature: const clamp = (v: number, a: number, b: number)

nodes.name: mono
nodes.documentation: JetBrains Mono advances 0.6 em per character, so text widths are exact.

nodes.name: showLoading
nodes.documentation: Shows one loading line with a cursor at the top of the code column, or hides it. The code viewer hides while it shows.

nodes.name: showNotice
nodes.documentation: Shows a notice at the top of the code column, or hides it. A notice stays until the next step or load.

nodes.name: showReader
nodes.documentation: Shows or hides the code header and the code viewer. They hide while no deck is loaded.

nodes.name: showShell
nodes.signature: function showShell(badge: string, color: string, desc: string, meta: string, alert = false)
nodes.documentation:
Fills the code column and empties the flow band while no deck is loaded. The chrome stays visible and inert.
 An alert text goes to screen readers at once. A deck part returns its own elements to the shell state when the deck is destroyed.

nodes.name: setChrome
nodes.documentation: Enables or disables every control that needs a deck, and dims the key help while the keys do nothing.

nodes.name: fail
nodes.documentation:
Shows a load failure in the code column, with one recovery step.
 A failure of a load that a newer load replaced is dropped: the newer load owns the page.

nodes.name: closeDeck
nodes.documentation: Destroys the deck and the diff view.

nodes.name: openArtifact
nodes.signature: async function openArtifact(file: string, flowName: string | null, step: number, notice: string | null = null)
nodes.documentation: Loads one codebase, verifies its graph, and opens the requested flow. A failure shows unless a newer load started.

nodes.name: openFlow
nodes.signature: async function openFlow(next: FlowEntry | null, step: number, notice: string | null = null)
nodes.documentation:
Loads one flow of the current codebase and the source of its step functions, then replaces the deck.
 A failed source load still plays the flow: every code viewer shows the unreadable note.

nodes.name: openDiff
nodes.signature: async function openDiff(name: string, step: number)
nodes.documentation:
Loads one PR diff and plays its After flow under the current graph, with the overview at step 0.
 The deck shows each step's diff in place of its source.

nodes.name: openPicker
nodes.documentation: Opens the codebase or flow list under its badge.

nodes.name: badgeHtml
nodes.signature: function badgeHtml(id: string, cls: string, inner: string, label: string | null): string
nodes.documentation: A name badge: a button that opens a picker when `label` is set, else a plain label. `inner` is escaped markup.

nodes.name: renderRepoBadge
nodes.documentation: The codebase badge: a picker when the index holds more than one codebase.

nodes.name: nameTab
nodes.documentation: Names the browser tab after the step, the flow, and the codebase.

nodes.name: renderFlowBand
nodes.documentation:
The flow badge and its freshness in the top band, or an empty band without a flow, and the page heading.
 The badge is a picker when the codebase has more than one flow.

nodes.name: flow
nodes.documentation: A small frozen flow: each step is `[id, cluster key]`, and each cluster label is its key in capitals.

nodes.name: row
nodes.signature: const row = (kind: DiffRow["kind"], beforeStep: string | null, afterStep: string | null, added = 0, removed = 0, path = "src/a.rs"): DiffRow

nodes.name: fn
nodes.signature: const fn = (name: string, cluster: string | null): DeckFunction

nodes.name: FactNode
nodes.documentation: A fact node and a fact edge of the demo artifact, which the fixture graphs copy.

nodes.name: must
nodes.signature: function must<T>(value: T | null | undefined, what = "value"): T
nodes.documentation: Returns the value, or fails the test when the value is missing.

nodes.name: graphDocument
nodes.signature: function graphDocument({ drop = [] }: { drop?: string[] } = {}): GraphDocument
nodes.documentation: A graph document that holds the fact nodes of the fixture artifact, their modules, and their edges.

nodes.name: smallGraph
nodes.signature: function smallGraph(paths: string[], callables: [path: string, name: string][] = []): GraphDocument
nodes.documentation: A graph document with the given callables. Each callable key is `<path>::callable:<name>`.
